rationale: This resolves YES if the deposit rate is unchanged at the Oct 28-29 meeting. The ECB raised the rate to 2.50% on Sept 10, and analysts point to December for any further hike, with MUFG seeing the cycle as complete. The ECB rarely hikes at back-to-back meetings when it has signalled a pause. September inflation of 3.8% is the main upside risk, so the number is not higher. A search result showed a market price; I ignored it.

This needs the Dome of the Rock physically destroyed before Netanyahu's term ends, and the election is Oct 27. The base rate is essentially zero, and there is no evidence of any such plan. Floor value.

The blockade was reimposed in July and CENTCOM said on Oct 16 that it is still in force and working. Talks are reported deadlocked, and Trump rejected Iran's ceasefire and reopening plan in late September. A deal that lifts the blockade within about six weeks is possible but unlikely given the escalation over tankers in Hormuz. Some weight goes to a sudden Trump deal or suspension after the midterms.

This needs a signed US-Iran Hormuz agreement announced by Nov 2 AND Democrats winning the Senate. Talks are deadlocked, the IRGC calls Hormuz 'closed', and both sides claim control of the strait, so an agreement within 16 days is about 4%. Non-market models put Democratic Senate control at roughly 55-60%. The product is about 2%.

Serbian incumbent lists have won the most seats in every election since 2012, and they control the media and administrative resources. The pro-government Faktor Plus poll (Sept) has United Serbia at 48.6% vs 37.1% for the Student List. Independent CRTA polling (June) had the Student List ahead, and its hypothetical two-bloc poll shows the opposition at 58%. The opposition consolidating behind the Student List is the strongest case against. I lean to the incumbent but keep real uncertainty. A search result showed a market price; I ignored it.

This resolves NO only if a US air or missile strike hits Iranian land by Nov 15. Strikes at sea do not count. Reports say large-scale US strikes on Iranian territory are paused and that Trump said he would not attack Iran before the midterms, which covers most of the window. Risks are the tanker war, Trump reportedly weighing renewed action, and the Nov 4-15 period after the election. Past pauses have repeatedly broken down, which holds this number down.

Mainstream polls (Channel 12, Kan, Maariv) put Likud at 18-21 seats, and averages are about 21-22. Channel 14, the outlier, has 29. Likud has sometimes beaten its final polls by 2-5 seats (2019, 2022), so 25+ is possible but needs a sizeable polling miss. Ten days remain.

Florida voted about R+13 in 2024. Republican Ashley Moody leads Democrat Angie Nixon by about 5-8 points in averages, and one forecaster rates the race Likely R. One St. Pete Polls survey shows a tie, and the national environment favors Democrats, so this is not higher.

The Supreme Court's Sept 14 order kept the injunction against the USPS rule in place through the Nov 3 election. USPS has said it will not implement the rule for 2026 without relief from the courts. No new court action is visible, and the election is about two weeks away.

This resolves YES if no new Pro-labeled Gemini model is publicly released by Nov 1. Google's October frontier release was 'Gemini 4 Argon' (Oct 13), which is not labeled Pro. Gemini 3.5 Pro is still 'testing with partners' with no date, and 3.1 Pro is the newest Pro on the API page. Rumors of an October Pro launch and Google's fast release pace keep about a 20% chance of a Pro release in the remaining two weeks.

Wilson leads the split Republican field but trails Democrat Kreiss-Tomkins in first choices (AARP: 40 vs 20; Cygnal: 44 vs 24). Ranked-choice simulations show the Democrat winning because Republican voters don't reliably rank Wilson. Cook moved the race to Lean D. Alaska's Republican lean and the large number of undecided voters keep her chance well above zero.

Trump won in 2024, so this resolves YES only if federal action legalizes cannabis or removes criminal penalties for personal possession by Nov 3. The April 2026 Schedule III move covers only medical and FDA-approved marijuana. Adult-use marijuana stays in Schedule I, and rescheduling does not remove penalties for possession in any case. No legalization bill is near passage, and about two weeks remain.
